text:
marta: opened PR to add equinox8b model card + SDK v4 migration snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5442 Preview: https://deploy-preview.example/5442 — includes supported_variants, quantization_profiles, max_sequence_length (12k), and a short perf/throughput section. PTAL for docs + eng review.

liam: can you include p50/p95 for 8k and 12k on A100 and an estimate for an rtx6000-class card? ops wants numbers to recommend variants. also add minimal Node and Python streaming examples.

marta: added microbench numbers: 8k p50 460 tok/s @A100, p95 350; 12k p50 295 tok/s, p95 230. RTX6000-ish ~60% of A100 figures (noted in table). added Python + Node streaming snippets under "Examples".

niko: tiny schema nit: frontmatter used "seq_max" — our catalog schema requires "max_sequence_length". CI will fail. can you rename?

marta: good catch — updated frontmatter to "max_sequence_length" and pushed.

liam: also include a short embeddings fallback pattern for CPU-only hosts (copy-paste config). call out recommended variant names and expected perf hit.

marta: added embeddings fallback section recommending `variant: \"sparse-lite\"` or `quant_profile: \"cpu-int8\"` for small hosts. note: expect ~3-5x slower embed throughput on 4GB CPU VMs vs A100. linked to bench artifact: https://bench.internal/equinox8b/5442

anya: tiny link nit: the quant profiles anchor points to `#quant-profiles` but the site uses `#quantization-profiles` in headings. will 404 in prod.

marta: fixed anchor to `#quantization-profiles` and updated TOC. pushed.

liam: can eng-ml weigh in on the CPU fallback wording? avoid absolute claims about generation quality. @niko?

niko: tweaked wording: "CPU quant fallbacks may increase latency ~2-4x and can affect short-token choices; run quick evals on representative prompt sets before rollout." linked an eval command to the internal harness.

marta: added Node streaming snippet (async iterator) and Python streaming example. Python example:

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
for chunk in client.generate(model="equinox8b", input="Write a short summary:", stream=True).stream():
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

Node example:

```js
const { Client } = require('@redwood/sdk')
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const stream = client.generate({ model: 'equinox8b', input: 'Hello', stream: true })
for await (const chunk of stream) process.stdout.write(chunk.text)
```

Added a one-line curl for quick smoke tests as well.

ci-bot: preview build succeeded ✅ — staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/5442. Lint: 1 warning (link style) resolved.

docs-bot: please request final reviews from @liam @niko @anya. migration checklist added to PR description (field rename to max_sequence_length, new quant_profile enums, examples updated for SDK v4). plan to merge after one approval and CI green. :rocket:
